scope.summary: Implement the layered texture stack, the LIE equivalent (spec 13.22; REQ-038, PREQ-034): ordered non-destructive layers (decals, tattoos, makeup, region fixes) with masks, blend modes, and opacity per UDIM tile, plus a deterministic bake-on-export flatten - sources never mutated, composites always reproducible.
acceptance_criteria: SkinLayerStack: ordered layers (base, decal, tattoo, makeup, region-fix) each with mask ref, blend mode from a documented set (normal/multiply/overlay at minimum), opacity, and UDIM-tile scope; fully non-destructive - layers stored, composite derived.
Deterministic flatten: bake-on-export composites the stack to flat PBR maps; identical stack input produces byte-identical bake output (hash-pinned test).
CRUD via typed API with event-before-row persistence; stack state persists via the dated additive migration and replays from the EventLedger.
Layer edits never mutate source textures, proven by source-hash stability across an edit session.
scope.risk_if_missed: A destructive texture pipeline loses tattoos, makeup, and decals on every re-bake; the LIE-equivalent stack with deterministic flatten is what keeps skin editable in-suite while staying portable to third-party renderers (REQ-038, PREQ-034).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
